findings.text: The registry records the company's status as active, and it has been incorporated on 22 June 2004.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next accounts due 31 December 2026 and the last accounts made up to 31 December 2024.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next statement due 10 July 2027 and the last made up to 26 June 2026.
There are 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 555 (appointed 28 April 2026) and PERSON 556 (appointed 16 October 2023), and 1 other officer.
One person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2111, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights and the right to appoint and remove directors.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 555 was appointed as a director on 28 April 2026 and PERSON 563 resigned as a director on 26 May 2026.
Across the 2 current directors checked, 50 other companies were found, of which 6 are recorded as dissolved; this count may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
